text: What if you checked into a hospital for help… but the people responsible for protecting you became your worst nightmare?
January twenty ten. Havana, Cuba. A rare cold front swept across the island. Inside a psychiatric hospital known as Mazorra, something horrifying was happening.
text0: January 2010. Havana, Cuba. A rare cold front swept across the island. Inside a psychiatric hospital known as Mazorra, something horrifying was happening.

text: Patients were exposed to freezing temperatures. Windows were reportedly broken. Blankets and warm clothing were missing. Some patients were severely malnourished.
Then people started dying. One after another. By the time the tragedy was discovered, twenty-six patients were dead.

text: But the cold wasn't the entire story. Investigators uncovered serious negligence and corruption. Essential supplies had reportedly been stolen or sold.
In twenty eleven, more than a dozen hospital officials and employees were sentenced to prison. The hospital's director received fifteen years.

text: And here's the most disturbing part. There was no supernatural monster lurking inside Mazorra. The horror was entirely human.
Twenty-six people entered a place meant to care for them… and never made it out alive. This is Plot Twist with A and R.
